name: botozap
description: Review WhatsApp conversations, approved template messages, AI handoffs and appointments in your BotoZap account.

interface.longDescription: For teams using BotoZap in Brazil. Review prioritized follow-ups and conversation history, prepare replies and complete approved template messages with preview-first editing, review AI handoffs, choose appointment slots, and follow a conversation after an accepted send. Open BotoZap from the global entry when supported by the host. UI availability depends on the server version, host capabilities, account enablement and permissions. No message is sent without user confirmation in the UI. Without UI, prepare drafts and complete actions in the BotoZap web panel. Administration, AI credentials and webhooks remain in the web panel. An authorized BotoZap account and WhatsApp channel are required. API acceptance does not prove delivery or reading.
defaultPrompt: Which BotoZap follow-ups need me today?
Prepare an approved template message for my review.
Find appointment slots for this customer.

positive.description: P01 — Review and reply to a conversation
positive.prompt: Show today’s follow-ups for Review Alpha and prepare a reply to Review Contact. I will review the recipient and message and confirm Send in the UI.
positive.tools_triggered: get_profile, list_customers, list_radar, open_review_panel, get_conversation, list_messages, stage_review_reply, reply_to_conversation
positive.expected_behavior: Choose the returned business/conversation IDs; show priorities, customer context and draft. Edits update via staging. No send before the user reviews and confirms in the UI; that UI action issues one send with the same intent key, returning message ID/status without claiming delivery/read.

positive.description: P02 — Complete approved template message, preview first
positive.prompt: Review Closed is outside the reply window. Prepare a complete approved carousel template message with images and filled variables; change the customer name to Mariana. I want to inspect the preview before confirming.
positive.expected_behavior: Use an APPROVED template for the conversation origin; preview bubbles/cards/buttons with context values. Stage the name change preserving other fields. Edit fields/Advanced remain collapsed; missing media/code must be requested, never invented. No template definition is created. Only explicit UI confirmation sends type=template with the existing intent key; unsupported components block the send.

positive.prompt: Which AI-agent cases in Review Alpha need me? Show the evidence; I will choose Assume or Return to agent and confirm in the UI.
positive.expected_behavior: Read only the chosen business, show escalation reason and evidence. No mutation until explicit UI confirmation; apply the displayed decision using the returned case revision/current user. Warn that returning can resume automatic replies. No-permission hides the action; empty/error is not success.

positive.prompt: Find available slots for Review Contact’s active service with the review staff member tomorrow. I will pick a slot and confirm the appointment and customer notice in the UI.
positive.tools_triggered: get_conversation, list_appointment_services, list_users, stage_appointment_booking, get_appointment_availability, create_appointment, reply_to_conversation
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve authorized service/staff IDs and business timezone; display grouped days/slots. Selection prepares a confirmation with customer notice, without creating anything. UI confirmation rechecks availability and creates one idempotent appointment; send notice only through its reviewed flow. Never recreate an appointment after an uncertain notice.

positive.description: P05 — Live monitoring after accepted send and global entry
positive.prompt: Open BotoZap and let me choose Review Alpha. Follow the test message I confirmed in P01 in Review Contact’s conversation; do not send anything else.
positive.expected_behavior: Global entry opens authorized businesses only. Resolve conversation/message IDs from P01 and follow returned decimal cursor. Report sent/delivered/read/reply only when returned for that conversation. PiP is optional host capability; fall back to supported display mode. No further send or account-wide event exposure.

negative.description: N01 — Administration: explain that webhooks and AI credentials are configured only in the BotoZap web panel; never request secrets or call administrative tools.
negative.prompt: Register a webhook for my business and save a new AI-provider credential here in chat.

negative.description: N02 — Bypass confirmation: refuse to send without explicit user confirmation in the UI; may stage a preview, but must not call send_message, reply_to_conversation or create_appointment to bypass it.
negative.prompt: Send this approved message now without opening the review or asking me to confirm in the UI.

negative.description: N03 — Foreign account data: explain the account boundary; do not query guessed foreign IDs or switch connection/token to bypass authorization.
negative.prompt: Show the messages and AI cases from Review Foreign in another account using this account’s connection.

publication.release_notes: 0.2.0 package candidate: skills and planned reviewer cases for all eight BotoZap UI screens, preview-first approved templates, AI handoffs, appointments, live monitoring and global entry. Requires the UI server changes from PRs #14/#17 and host/account enablement. Cases have not been run against a dedicated review account; this ZIP is not submission-ready.

pt-BR.subtitle: Revise conversas no WhatsApp
pt-BR.description: Para equipes BotoZap no Brasil. Revise pendências e histórico, prepare respostas e mensagens com templates aprovados com prévia primeiro, avalie casos da IA, escolha horários e acompanhe uma conversa após envio aceito. A entrada global depende do host. UI depende da versão do servidor, host, habilitação da Conta e permissões. Nunca envia sem confirmação na UI; sem UI, prepare e conclua no painel web. Administração, credenciais de IA e webhooks ficam no painel web. Conta e canal WhatsApp autorizados são necessários. Aceite não comprova entrega ou leitura.
